name: probe bins in order of boundary distance
mechanism: descend a space-partitioning tree to the query's leaf, then visit other branches in order of how close the query is to their splitting boundaries using a priority queue, stopping after a fixed number of probes for an approximate nearest neighbour

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Best Bin First' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: find an approximate solution to the nearest neighbor search problem in very-high-dimensional spaces

fails_when: high dimension makes the boundary order uninformative
